message: Hi, I'm a student with a app development certification background. My overall academic average is 72.6% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in hacking and Business process analyst. I want to become a Network Security Engineer. My family can afford at most about USD 4000 per year. I live in Delhi. I'd strongly prefer to stay near home, though I might consider elsewhere in India.
explanation:
This program is located in Delhi, meeting your strong preference to stay near home. It offers an MBA in Business Analytics, which aligns well with your interest in Business Process Analysis and leverages your existing IT background.

This MTech program focuses on Computer Networks, directly addressing your goal of becoming a Network Security Engineer. It is located in Pune and requires a CS background, which you possess from your degree.

This MBA Technology Management program focuses on IT Management, providing relevant skills for both Business Process Analysis and Network Security. It is located in Hyderabad, which is a reasonable alternative to Delhi.

This MSc IT Management program offers foundational knowledge in business information systems and IT management, supporting your interest in Business Process Analysis. The tuition is very low ($800), keeping you well within your budget.

This MSc Information Systems program provides a strong business focus and is located in Coimbatore. It has low tuition ($2400) and meets your minimum grade requirement (71%), making it a solid option for career transition.
